lemmas.statement: For every history h of sealed events and switch markers and every engine state s, elems(s) <= elems(ereplay s h) (monotone element count).
lemmas.lean_skeleton:
theorem ereplay_elems_le (s : EState) (h : List EEvent) : elems s ≤ elems (ereplay s h) := by
  induction h generalizing s with
  | nil => simp [ereplay]
  | cons e t ih => sorry

lemmas.statement: If a history h leaves regime r from state s, then no later history reaches regime r again.
lemmas.lean_skeleton:
theorem no_return (s : EState) (h k : List EEvent) (hl : regime (ereplay s h) ≠ regime s) : regime (ereplay (ereplay s h) k) ≠ regime s := by
  sorry

lemmas.statement: If ereplay s h = s then every intermediate state along h has the regime of s.
lemmas.lean_skeleton:
theorem cycle_regime_const (s : EState) (h : List EEvent) (hc : ereplay s h = s) (p q : List EEvent) (hpq : p ++ q = h) : regime (ereplay s p) = regime s := by
  sorry
